findings.source_quote: ὅτι πολλαί μου εἰσὶν αἱ ἁμαρτίαι καὶ ποικίλαι.
findings.english_quote: ‘Manifold’ keeps the elevated tone and pairs well with ‘many’ to express diversity of sins.
findings.issue: The simplified edition's lexical record identifies its chosen rendering as “many and manifold” and explains that wording, but its actual text reads “My sins are many and various.” Both renderings convey the selected Greek; the concrete defect is inaccurate edition-specific disclosure, not the simplified translation.
findings.suggested_revision: Update the simplified lexical record to identify “many and various” as the chosen rendering and explain its preservation of both the number and diversity of the sins. Retain “many and manifold” as an alternative if desired. Review the corrected metadata before acceptance; no reader-text replacement is needed for this finding.

summary: Both reader texts faithfully cover the selected working Greek, preserving the repentance–understanding argument, cessation of evil, lavish good, self-humbling and chastising/tormenting, and the conditional promise of living. The bracketed supplement and working conjecture are disclosed rather than silently harmonized with alternatives. The witness notes agree with the bounded supplied reports; this assessment does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or certify exhaustive collation. The standard edition is accepted within that scope. The simplified edition requires a minor correction to its lexical disclosure, not its reader text.
